edges.detail: 1,142,785,690 XRP reported at 2026-10-30, approximately 1.80% of circulating supply
USD 86.5M at 2026-06-30 across five tracked funds
2026-10-28 target range held at 3.75%-4.00%; two dissenters preferred a 25bp hike; no XRP-specific causal link

hypotheses.claim: XRP ETF flows showed relative resilience on 2026-10-30 while BTC and ETH ETFs experienced large outflows.
supporting: XRP displayed +USD 0.2M net flow versus BTC -USD 643.3M and ETH -USD 155.7M.
disconfirming: Only 3 of 5 XRP funds reported; the XRP inflow was approximately 0.01% of reported net assets.
ETF creations/redemptions are T+1 and may reflect arbitrage/hedging rather than same-day directional demand.

hypotheses.claim: XRP ETFs have measurable institutional ownership through reportable 13F positions.
supporting: 127 institutions reported USD 179M across five XRP ETFs at 2026-06-30.
Goldman Sachs represented approximately 48% of reported 13F value.
disconfirming: 13F is lagged and excludes shorts, futures and retail; reported ETF shares are not direct XRP beneficial ownership.
Concentration in Goldman Sachs and a small number of market makers limits the breadth inference.

hypotheses.claim: The October 28 FOMC hold with two hike dissents is a restrictive macro backdrop for risk assets.
supporting: Target range remained 3.75%-4.00%; both dissenters preferred a 25bp hike; inflation remained elevated.
disconfirming: Economic activity was described as strong and the Committee maintained ample reserves; this is not evidence of an imminent hike.
No XRP-specific causal or predictive effect is established.

hypotheses.claim: ETF flows and 13F holdings alone provide a directional XRP price signal.
disconfirming: Daily flow is partial and T+1; 13F is lagged; no leakage-safe out-of-sample model validation has been completed.

limitations: ETF flow data are provider-aggregated and latest XRP session is partial.
13F holdings are quarter-end long reportable securities, not total institutional exposure.
Macro context is not a direct XRP causal feature.
